sc: Itchy palms and soles at 32 weeks, no rash → Obstetric cholestasis: bile acids
Itch with normal tests → Repeat in 1–2 weeks
f: Itch of palms and soles, no rash, 3rd trimester, worse at night · family history in a third
Serum bile acids > 10 µmol/L · ALT/AST 2–3× · exclude hepatitis, gallstones · ALP is unhelpful (placental)
Ursodeoxycholic acid 8–12 mg/kg/day · antihistamines only sedate · vitamin K if steatorrhoea
Bile acids ≥ 100: deliver 35–36 wk · 40–99: about 38 wk
Fetal: sudden stillbirth, meconium, preterm birth · maternal: vitamin K ↓ → PPH
trap: Bile acids above 100 mark high stillbirth risk · itch with rash is another disease · UDCA relieves itch but its effect on stillbirth is unproved
